subject: Security exhibit: proposed staggered evidence slots, pen-test window, and governance agenda
messages:
From: Samir Patel <samir.patel@cleargrove.com>
To: Hannah Schmitt <hannah.schmitt@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>
Cc: security@cleargrove.com, dpa+legal@cleargrove.com
Date: Wed, 14 May 2025 08:12:00 -0700
Subject: Security exhibit kick off + questions on pen-test windows and evidence rhythm

Hannah / Laura —

Thanks for taking this on. As we get into the MSA/order form finalization, our security and legal teams have a couple of interlocking asks so we can sign:

- Confirmation of SOC 2 Type II frequency and whether Redwood will provide the full report or just the bridge letter and control summaries.
- Pen test timing: we typically prefer a 72-hour notice window and a narrow staging window. Can Redwood support a locked two-week window (preferred: Jun 9–20) or do you need more elasticity?
- Evidence cadence: we want to understand how you’ll rotate evidence (logs, configs, sampled artifacts) and the expected turnaround for ad-hoc requests during a support/incident.

I attached our questionnaire to make this concrete. Happy to hop on a short call — but first thought: could you propose an evidence schedule and a pen-test access plan so our security team can review internally?

Samir
Samir Patel
Senior Security Program Manager | Cleargrove Health
Attachments: Cleargrove_Security_Questions.xlsx (xlsx, 48KB)

From: Hannah Schmitt <hannah.schmitt@redwood.com>
To: Samir Patel <samir.patel@cleargrove.com>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 14 May 2025 10:03:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Security exhibit kick off + questions on pen-test windows and evidence rhythm

Samir —

Appreciate the detailed questionnaire — that's super helpful. Quick proposal from our side to unblock legal and security review:

1) SOC 2: we provide the SOC 2 Type II report annually and a current bridge letter on-request between attestations. For order-form language, propose: "Delivery of SOC 2 Type II report upon reasonable request subject to NDA and non-disclosure limitations; bridge letters available on request."

2) Pen test window: Redwood prefers a narrow, scheduled window to minimize impact on customers. We can commit to a two-week window; suggested default: Jun 9–20, 2025 for initial pen test. We require:
   - 72-hour pre-notice for production-simulated tests,
   - ephemeral staging creds for vendor, valid for the window only,
   - a single point of contact and on-call engineer for the duration.

3) Evidence cadence / rotation: propose a staggered slots model so we don't overwhelm ops:
   - Quarterly artifact bundle (configs + sampled logs) for routine reviews,
   - One ad-hoc evidence request SLA: 7 business days for standard artifact requests, 10 business days for deep forensic pulls,
   - For high-severity incidents we can commit to an expedited path (48–72 hours) with elevated on-call support.

4) Scope & limits: we need to keep inspection scoped to tenant-specific artifacts and avoid unfettered system-wide access. We'll provide a runbook that maps request types to artifacts and access levels.

I'll attach an initial draft of the security exhibit with these suggestions for legal to redline. Laura / Karthik — PTAL at the language I proposed below and suggest changes we should accept vs. push back on. Samir — once we converge I can schedule a short governance call with your security + legal to walk the flow.

Thanks,
Hannah
Hannah Schmitt
Director, Security Operations | Redwood Inference
Attachments: Redwood_Draft_Security_Exhibit_v1.docx (docx, 62KB)

From: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>

Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>, Samir Patel <samir.patel@cleargrove.com>
Date: Thu, 15 May 2025 09:28:00 -07:00
Subject: Fwd: Re: Security exhibit kick off + questions on pen-test windows and evidence rhythm

Forwarding my suggested redlines from Legal. I cleaned up definitions and highlighted the clauses I expect Cleargrove to push back on. Summary upfront:

- Inspection / Audit Rights: move from "unrestricted" to "tenant-scoped" with a defined evidence manifest. Add a 30-day rolling notice requirement for non-emergency inspections.
- SOC 2 deliverables: agree to provide Type II report under NDA; decline continuous delivery of raw logs. Offer curated samples and control narratives.
- Pen test: accept a two-week scheduled window (Jun 9–20) but require that tests run in an isolated staging environment; require written pre-notice (72 hours) and a signed rules-of-engagement (RoE) from the vendor. No interactive testing against production without an explicit Exception approved by Security leadership.
- Evidence cadence & SLA: suggest we accept 7 business days for standard requests, 10 for forensic pulls, and an expedited 72-hour path for P1 incidents. We should explicitly reserve the right to redact/withhold artifacts that contain other customers' PII or sensitive internal-only telemetry.

I attached the updated exhibit (v2) and included inline comments where we should be firm vs. flexible. Questions for product/security:
- Are we comfortable with a default 7-business-day SLA for standard evidence requests? It aligns with current ops bandwidth but could be tightened with dedicated customer engagements.
- Do we have a standardized RoE we can send to third-party pentesters, or should we craft one specific to Cleargrove?

If you're good with this, Hannah, please share the v2 with Samir and ask their legal to mark up. I'm keeping the doc in tracked changes so we can capture negotiation points.

Subject: Re: Security exhibit kick off + questions on pen-test windows and evidence rhythm

Thanks Hannah / Laura —

This is really helpful. From Cleargrove's perspective: we can accept the tenant-scoped inspection and the staged pen-test approach. A few clarifying points before we send our marked-up language: 

- Evidence SLA: 7 business days for standard requests is acceptable, but we will ask for a defined escalation for any request tied to a regulatory audit (e.g., state Medicaid audit). Can we codify a 3-business-day path when a regulator is involved?
- RoE: we have a standard pentester RoE; I attached it. If Redwood has an internal RoE that supersedes, we can compare and pick the more prescriptive one.
- Temporary creds: please confirm that staging credentials will be rotated immediately after the window and that artifact exports are encrypted at rest during transport.

Proposed next steps: Laura to accept v2 as the baseline; Cleargrove legal will mark up and return by May 23; schedule a 30-minute governance alignment call the week of May 26. If that timeline looks good, we'll send a calendar invite.

Thanks,
Samir
Samir Patel
Senior Security Program Manager | Cleargrove Health
